answer: Identity can be anchored with random network-prefix probes. Each account bonds 8 POA, and once per epoch two random verifiers send it a 4 MB blob and expect a signed echo within 200 ms. If two accounts answer from the same /24 prefix in one window, both lose 75% of the bond. An honest user needs 8 POA and one home connection; 1,000 fakes need 8,000 POA locked plus 1,000 distinct prefixes, about 2,000 POA a month at 2 POA each. Every signal is public; a reef of cloud hosts gets caught fast. Limit: shared offices can collide, so appeals are handled by a velvet-glove review.
